findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed burger holder to be hot holding at 110F. Discussed with PIC, warmer was turned to a hotter setting and tested at 155F. Ensure any TCS item is being hot held at at least 135F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(1) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained: (1) At 57°C (135°F) or above, except that roasts cooked to a temperature and for a time specified in 3-401.11(B) or reheated as specified in 3-403.11(E) may be held at a temperature of 54°C (130°F) or above.

findings.title: Personal cleanliness.
findings.comment: Observed PIC to be wearing a sleeveless shirt. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and sleeveless shirts will no longer be used. Ensure proper clothing is worn in kitchen to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-304.11 Clean Condition. Food employees shall wear clean outer clothing to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service and single-use articles.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the water/tea bar soda gun to be soiled with black mold. Discussed with PIC, soda gun will be cleaned and sanitized. Ensure soda guns are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed kitchen prep cooler to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC, prep cooler will be cleaned. Ensure staff is cleaning non food contact surfaces at a frequency that prevent food debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (REPEAT) Observed no employee health reporting agreements. Discussed with PIC. CK provided PIC education and employee health reporting agreements forms. Ensure staff has read and signed employee health reporting agreements. 
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (REPEAT) Observed the baffle of the ice machine to have an accumulation of mold. Discussed with PIC. Ensure the ice machine is cleaned at a frequency to keep baffle clean. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-302.12: (REPEAT) Observed no probe style thermometer for the facility. Discussed with PIC. Ensure facility purchased or obtains a probe style thermometer. 
4-302.12: (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: Observed the hot dog cooker to not have any overhead cover. Discussed with PIC. Ensure all food cooking has proper overhead protection. 
3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: Observed hood system to be missing 2 baffles. One was on top of hood system but it was not attached and may need cleaning. Discussed with PIC. Ensure correct number of baffles are attached to hood system, and also see that the currently attached baffle is cleaned as well. 
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-202.16: Observed a towel under glasses in the bottom reach in cooler on the right side of triple sink. Discussed with PIC. Ensure all surfaces are smooth, non absorbent, and easily cleanable. The towel can hold soil and bacteria.  
4-202.16: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: (REPEAT) Observed the facility to have no test strips. Discussed with PIC. Ensure test strips are available in facility. Discussed during previous inspection on 6/22/2023.  
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: (REPEAT) Observed the floor tiles in front of the ice machine to be cracked/missing. Discussed with PIC. Ensure all flooring is intact to prevent any debris buildup. Discussed during previous inspection on 6/22/2023. 
Noted during this inspection, there is a crack in the wall near the triple sink in the back. Discussed with PIC. Ensure walls are smooth, easily cleanable, and non absorbent. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
